item.title: Reddit schedules RSS and public API shutdowns, citing scraping abuse
item.description: Reddit says RSS support will end November 13 and public API access by March 2027, citing scraping and automated abuse; the API change would affect third-party tools, including AI assistants.

item.title: Magnitude launches local inference engine for coding agents
item.description: Magnitude says its open-source engine tunes kernels to a user’s hardware, connects to coding agents including OpenCode and Codex, and runs open models up to twice as fast as llama.cpp.

item.title: Pi adds MCP support to its core harness
item.description: Pi’s developer says MCP is now built into the harness, with tools exposed through a JavaScript sandbox and support for deferred tool loading; the post notes that MCP servers remain difficult to compose.

item.title: Opus 5.5 drift benchmark has seven of 30 days; no result yet
item.description: The pre-registered livenerf benchmark reports seven days of data and says its first comparison is not due until about October 24; it has not established whether Opus 5.5 degraded.

item.title: Strata launches governed analytics layer with agents for live data
item.description: Strata says its semantic layer lets agents query governed live data, applies row-level security and refuses semantically invalid queries; it also supports coding-agent-assisted configuration.

item.title: Anthropic interview outlines Claude Code harness features and security work
item.description: A podcast recap describes Claude Code features including Mods, Projects and multiplayer workflows, and discusses Anthropic’s approach to agent security and frontier deployment.

item.title: Opus 5.5 roundup reports coding and model comparisons
item.description: A roundup relays attributed benchmark results and community impressions about Opus 5.5 and other models, including reported coding-agent preferences; these claims are not independently substantiated in the card.
